issues.text: Stock screen ends with an English-language 'Items' table (Invoice 1042, Purchase order, 'Add item', 'In progress', Edit/Delete) that is a generic template unrelated to the French robot workshop and clashes with the rest.
Placeholder-looking 'Items' data (Invoice, Quality check, owners Luis/Marta) on Stock breaks the domain realism of the robot workshop.
Very small text for secondary labels, pills, hints and table cells (about 9-11px), with light grey on white sub-labels such as 'Minimum 3 kg' and card captions.
Robots grid cards are very tall with long, repetitive stat bars and large empty areas. R-03 Hexa and R-02 Scout cards are cut off at the bottom, and the card heights are uneven.
At 1280 the Stock page leaves a large empty area under the alerts panel next to the inventory table, and the content is narrow within the viewport; the top KPI card floats awkwardly beside the table.
R-03 Hexa card layout differs from the others (status banner, ring and badge stacked), the 'En pause' state is easy to miss, and progress bars are empty/grey so they carry little information.

critic.summary: A coherent, realistic French robot-workshop UI with clear titles and primary buttons, but a leftover English generic 'Items' table on Stock, tiny text, and tall, uneven robot cards with wasted space pull it down.
